name: Exotel (Intelligent Voice Agents / Harmony)
target_customers: Enterprise contact centres in India and the Middle East; logos incl. HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, Flipkart, Swiggy, Zomato, Uber

entry_price.notes: Page shows '$70' with no billing period stated; XPrime includes 'native chat and voice bot'. Voice Streaming (AgentStream) is excluded and sold separately; no AI voice-agent per-minute price published.

hindi_hinglish.evidence: AI Voicebot page says the bot is 'fluent in Hindi, English, and Hinglish'.

indic_languages.evidence: Claims 'regional & global language support' but docs name only English and Hindi; other Indian languages not listed.

outbound_inbound.evidence: Docs: bots answer inbound calls on an assigned number; outbound runs via Campaigns with contact lists and a Voicebot applet.

live_transfer.evidence: Unresolved calls transfer to a human agent / agent groups with a conversation summary and captured inputs.

mid_call_actions.evidence: Agent uses APIs for real-time actions: checks availability to book/reschedule appointments, shares payment links.

no_code_builder.evidence: Bots are created in the console from a custom prompt plus uploaded files, with Identity/Objective/Behaviour and config tabs.

api_webhooks.evidence: APIs for real-time actions and Voicebot applet WebSocket/HTTPS endpoint documented; outbound webhooks for voice agents not described.

built_in_crm.evidence: Contact-centre plans include contact lists, dialers and CRM integrations; no native lead pipeline described for voice agents.

lead_source_connectors.evidence: No Meta/Google lead-form connectors that trigger AI calls found on the pages read.

whatsapp_followup.evidence: Contact centre 'unifies voice, SMS, WhatsApp'; WhatsApp follow-up tied to voice-agent calls is not described.

post_call_analysis.evidence: Recordings, transcripts, resolution status and unresolved-reason breakdown; per-call extracted fields/dispositions not described.

call_qa.evidence: Voicebot analytics show bot health (Healthy/Warning/Critical), resolution rate, latency, tool success; Harmony AQM evaluates AI-handled calls.

human_call_intelligence.evidence: Conversation Quality Analysis scores calls against SOPs/quality parameters and surfaces coaching for human agents.

telephony_included.evidence: Indian virtual numbers used for bot campaigns; AgentStream page claims DLT, TRAI and UL-VNO compliance (search snippet).

languages_claimed: Hindi, English and Hinglish; 'regional & global language support' (no full list published)
india_compliance: AgentStream page (search snippet) states PCI DSS, DLT, TRAI and UL-VNO compliance; Exotel BFSI blog says onboarding includes DLT-registered 140/1600-series numbers.

scale.customers_claimed: 25B+ interactions a year (homepage); 7,000+ enterprises (exec interview, Aug 2026)
scale.last_round: Series D, $40M led by Steadview Capital, Jan 2022

notable_2025_2026: Launched Harmony, an AI-native CX platform unifying voice, messaging, conversational intelligence and human-in-the-loop, on 19 Nov 2025; Middle East rollout Feb 2026.

sources.ratings: https://www.g2.com/products/exotel-customer-communication-platform/reviews (search snippet; G2 seller page shows 4.3 across 340 reviews for all Exotel products)

name: SquadStack (Voice AI agents + human advisors)
target_customers: Consumer brands and BFSI sales teams; '60+ consumer brands' incl. Kotak Mahindra Bank, IndiaMART, Flipkart, Swiggy

per_minute_from.notes: Homepage FAQ: voice AI priced per minute, 'typically ₹2 to ₹5', with setup costs for enterprise deployments. Pricing page: billed only for live AI talk time, one-time setup fee per use case, quote after discovery call.

hindi_hinglish.evidence: Supports Hindi and code-mixed speech such as Hinglish and Taminglish with mid-sentence switching.

indic_languages.evidence: Nine languages: Hindi, English, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Marathi, Malayalam, Gujarati, Bengali.

outbound_inbound.evidence: Outbound campaigns and lead outreach are the focus; inbound AI calling not described.

live_transfer.evidence: 'Complex conversations still warm-transfer to a human, by design'; human advisor pod handles handoffs.

mid_call_actions.evidence: Agents qualify leads, open accounts, book appointments and take payment commitments on the call.

no_code_builder.evidence: No self-serve builder; agents set up by a forward-deployed engineer; 'Control Tower' exposes 100+ configurations.

api_webhooks.evidence: Lead and workflow APIs: webhooks and JSON APIs, plus custom connectors.

lead_source_connectors.evidence: Leads arrive via webhooks, JSON APIs and third-party connectors built per client; no native Meta/Google lead-ad connector named.

whatsapp_followup.evidence: Call, WhatsApp, SMS and in-app channels share context for follow-ups.

post_call_analysis.evidence: Reporting, analytics and voice-of-customer insights; per-call summary/disposition fields not explicitly described.

call_qa.evidence: 'AI plus human quality audits across 23 parameters'; QA page doesn't say AI-agent calls are scored.

human_call_intelligence.evidence: AI Call Quality Analysis scores agent calls on 23 quality parameters with transcripts.

telephony_included.evidence: Dialer included in price; multi-operator routing over Exotel, Knowlarity, Ozonetel, Gupshup with failover.

languages_claimed: 9 languages: Hindi, English, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Marathi, Malayalam, Gujarati, Bengali; code-mixed Hinglish/Taminglish
india_compliance: TRAI DND scrubbing and 9:30 AM-8:30 PM calling window enforced; DLT registered headers and pre-approved templates; DPDP consent gating, opt-out and India data residency; ISO 27001/27701, SOC 2 Type II; RBI recovery-agent guidelines.
